description:
Returns all containers (default: all=true)

HTTP: GET /v1/docker/containers
Category: Docker
Required scopes: docker:read
Returns: {status, data: array of {id, name, image, image_id, status, state, created, ports, mounts, networks, labels, restart_policy, … (+9 more)}, success}
Read-only.

_fields.description: Comma-separated item fields to keep, e.g. "id,domain_name,php_version" — trims large items to what you need.

_limit.description: Keep only the first N items of the returned list (applied by this MCP server, not the panel). Use on large lists.

_match.description: Keep only items whose JSON contains this text (case-insensitive), e.g. a domain name or status.

all.description: false = only running containers; anything else (default) = every container

name: panelica_docker_get_v1_docker_containers
